N = A * B - 1

# A partition is encoded by B set bits. The bit for row i is at
# position (row length) + B - 1 - i.

        while moves:
            bit = moves & -moves

            # length A only after the row below attains length A-1.

        return False

    aoki = ((1 << m) - 1) << n
